purpose: Freeze the IQ2-versus-Q2 performance comparison before generating either canonical result.
hypotheses: UD-IQ2_XXS will use less VRAM and decode faster than UD-Q2_K_XL.
UD-Q2_K_XL may justify its performance and memory cost through the separate Phase 2 objective quality signal.
If both models fully offload, this phase is a quantization and memory comparison rather than a CPU-offload comparison.

measurement_order.limitation: A fixed sequential order does not eliminate thermal or time-order effects; per-run temperature and power telemetry are retained.

comparison_rules.primary_speed_metric: mean server generation tokens per second
comparison_rules.latency_metric: mean client total latency for 256 completion tokens
comparison_rules.memory_metric: peak sampled VRAM used and minimum sampled VRAM free
comparison_rules.variability: sample standard deviation and coefficient of variation across three measured repetitions
comparison_rules.quality_context: Phase 2 ten-task pass@1 triage is reported separately and is not recomputed from performance runs

exit_condition: Both canonical records complete under the frozen controls, calculations reproduce independently, and the speed/memory tradeoff is documented without generalizing beyond the tested workload.
